names: UCSF Orthopaedic Institute at Mission Bay
summary: A UCSF Health outpatient medical building at 1500 Owens Street in Mission Bay South, housing the UCSF Orthopaedic Institute along with Radiology, Sports Medicine, and Physical Therapy & Rehabilitation clinics. The Orthopaedic Institute opened here October 1, 2009 -- the first UCSF clinical service to open at Mission Bay -- and DataSF's Assessor tax roll records the parcel's construction year as 2009.

milestones.text: UCSF Orthopaedic Institute opens at 1500 Owens St, the first UCSF clinical service to open at Mission Bay
